title: Cursor cut its India price to $7, and its own AI models are why

content_html:
Cursor has cut the price of AI coding in India to about $7 a month. The interesting part is how it can afford to.

The startup launched Cursor Start on Monday, a ₹649 plan sold only in India, TechCrunch reported. It sits well below the $20 Pro subscription. It is also the first time Cursor has localised its pricing anywhere.

India earned the discount. It is already Cursor’s third-largest market and has the highest concentration of power users on the platform. Its user base tripled to more than three million developers in a year, according to Inc42. GitHub counts more than 27 million developers in the country, second only to the US.

Why $7 is not a loss

The plan runs on Cursor’s own models, Composer and Grok 4.5. It leaves out the frontier systems from OpenAI and Anthropic that power the top tier. That choice is the whole trick.

Renting the most expensive models is what makes cheap plans lose money. Running on models it controls is what keeps the maths viable at a third of the Pro price.

“We felt that we had an opportunity there to right-size the commercial model and drive scale,” Simon Green, Cursor’s head of Asia-Pacific and Japan, told TechCrunch. He said the plan is sustainable rather than a loss leader, precisely because it leans on the cheaper in-house models.

Start includes cloud agents, the iOS app, plugins and higher usage than the free tier. It drops the OpenAI and Anthropic frontier models, plus advanced features like Bugbot and the SDK. It is billed in rupees, takes cards and UPI, and blocks access over VPNs.

Cheap here, dearer there

The India cut lands in a revealing week. The Information reported that Cursor’s customers are fighting price hikes in contract talks, as it pushes enterprise rates up.

The two moves are less a contradiction than a strategy. Cursor is discounting where it is buying scale, and raising where it has pricing power. That is a familiar tactic as the economics of agentic coding bite. GitHub recently froze new Copilot sign-ups when usage costs outran its pricing, and the industry is still working out the real cost of enterprise AI.

The India land grab

Cursor is not the first to price for India. OpenAI launched its sub-$5 ChatGPT Go there before rolling it out elsewhere, and Anthropic localised Claude’s pricing for the country this month. The biggest AI firms are all chasing the same fast-growing pool of developers.

Cursor is hiring on the ground too, adding sales, support and government-affairs staff across Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Mumbai. Green said Cursor could extend localised pricing elsewhere if the India model works. “It’d be crazy to say we would never do it elsewhere,” he said.

Under new ownership soon

All of this arrives with a new owner in the wings. SpaceX agreed in June to buy Cursor’s parent, Anysphere, in a $60bn all-stock deal due to close this quarter. The two have partnered on coding tools since April.

Green said Cursor will run independently until the deal closes, and that the India plans predate it. He added that SpaceX’s Starlink presence in the country could help Cursor expand faster afterwards. The discount, then, is an opening move in a market Cursor means to own well before it becomes a rocket company’s software arm.

content_html_zh:
Cursor 已将印度 AI 编码的价格降低至每月 7 美元左右。 有趣的是它如何负担得起。

据 TechCrunch 报道，这家初创公司于周一推出了 Cursor Start，售价 649 卢比，仅在印度销售。 它的价格远低于 20 美元的 Pro 订阅费。 这也是 Cursor 首次在任何地方进行本地化定价。

印度获得了折扣。 它已经是 Cursor 的第三大市场，并且是该平台上高级用户最集中的市场。 据 Inc42 称，其用户群在一年内增长了两倍，达到超过 300 万开发者。 GitHub 在该国拥有超过 2700 万开发者，仅次于美国。

为什么 7 美元不是损失

该计划运行在 Cursor 自己的模型 Composer 和 Grok 4.5 上。 它忽略了 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 为顶层提供动力的前沿系统。 这个选择就是整个技巧。

租用最昂贵的型号是廉价计划赔钱的原因。 在它控制的模型上运行是保持数学可行性的原因，而价格只有 Pro 版的三分之一。

Cursor 亚太和日本负责人西蒙·格林 (Simon Green) 告诉 TechCrunch：“我们认为，我们有机会调整商业模式并扩大规模。” 他表示，该计划是可持续的，而不是亏损的，正是因为它依赖于更便宜的内部模式。

Start 包括云代理、iOS 应用程序、插件和比免费套餐更高的使用量。 它放弃了 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 前沿模型，以及 Bugbot 和 SDK 等高级功能。 它以卢比计费，接受银行卡和 UPI，并阻止通过 VPN 进行访问。

这里便宜，那里贵

印度在一周内砍伐土地。 据 The Information 报道，Cursor 的客户正在合同谈判中反对价格上涨，因为这推高了企业费率。

这两项举措与其说是矛盾，不如说是一种策略。 Cursor 在购买规模的地方打折，在有定价能力的地方加价。 这是一种熟悉的策略，就像代理编码的经济学原理一样。 最近，当使用成本超出其定价时，GitHub 冻结了新的 Copilot 注册，而业界仍在计算企业人工智能的实际成本。

印度的土地掠夺

Cursor并不是第一个为印度定价的公司。 OpenAI 在那里推出了低于 5 美元的 ChatGPT Go，然后在其他地方推出，Anthropic 本月在该国本地化了 Claude 的定价。 最大的人工智能公司都在追逐同样快速增长的开发者群体。

Cursor 也在实地招聘，在班加罗尔、金奈、海得拉巴和孟买增加销售、支持和政府事务人员。 格林表示，如果印度模式奏效，Cursor 可以将本地化定价扩展到其他地方。 “如果说我们永远不会在其他地方这样做，那就太疯狂了，”他说。

很快就会有新的所有权

所有这一切都伴随着新主人的到来。 SpaceX 于 6 月同意以 600 亿美元的全股票交易收购 Cursor 的母公司 Anysphere，该交易将于本季度完成。 自四月份以来，两人就在编码工具方面进行了合作。

格林表示，Cursor 将独立运营直至交易完成，而印度的计划早于交易完成。 他补充说，SpaceX 在该国的 Starlink 业务可能有助于 Cursor 之后更快地扩张。 因此，这次折扣是 Cursor 在成为火箭公司的软件部门之前就拥有的市场的一个开放举措。
